snippet.title: Hero Strike Trailer
snippet.description:
Your army. Your hero. Your legend.
Hero Strike is a 3v3 fantasy strategy game. Draft your army, choose your hero, and fight alongside your team to destroy the enemy citadel.
Coming to PC in Spring 2027.
⚔️ Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5415160
💬 Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/WCm77jFuMQ
🌐 Official website: https://herostrikeonline.com/
#HeroStrike #StrategyGame #RTS #PCGaming
